<!-- --8<-- [start:hero] -->
The toroidal lumped-element detector of the quick start (R = H = 2.0 m, NI = 1.0 × 10⁶ A turns), solved axisymmetrically and drawn by axionFEM's renderer as a 3D cutaway. Colour: the static field |B| on the cut planes (viridis, 0 to 0.167 T), which is confined to the toroid volume; where it vanishes the planes are left uncoloured. Pink: field lines of the pickup mode in the bore. Signal coupling Ψ = 3.088 × 10⁻⁷ H T m², pickup inductance L_p = 1.458 µH, with third-order elements; second-order elements agree to 4 × 10⁻⁶.
<!-- --8<-- [end:hero] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:cavity] -->
**Beta.** Cavity haloscope: E_z of the three lowest TM modes of a copper cavity of 210 mm radius with a 50.8 mm copper tuning rod at an illustrative off-centre position (cross-section eigensolver; each mode scaled to its largest |E_z|; dark lines: nodal lines). Large: the TM₀₁₀-like mode, f = 625.4 MHz, form factor C = 0.616, which an independent method-of-particular-solutions calculation reproduces to 3 × 10⁻¹⁰ in f and 1 × 10⁻⁸ in C. Small: the next two TM modes (882.9 and 1017 MHz); their sign changes give C = 0 and 0.025.
<!-- --8<-- [end:cavity] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:srf] -->
**Beta.** SRF heterodyne cavity: the 60 L closed cylinder of Lasenby (arXiv:1912.11056), radius 20 cm, with the length 47.10 cm (d/R = 2.355) at which the TE012 pump and the TM013 signal are degenerate (59.2 L, 1.1139 GHz). Colour: their overlap density E₁·B₀ on the meridional section, in units of the product of the rms fields (axisymmetric eigensolver). Its volume average gives the overlap factor η₁₀ = 0.4386, so η₁₀² = 0.192 against the published C₀₁ = 0.19; the closed form agrees to 7 × 10⁻⁶ and two meshes agree to 6 × 10⁻⁶.
<!-- --8<-- [end:srf] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:readout] -->
**Beta.** Readout and SQUID chain: noise of a resonant readout of the quick-start toroid (L_p and Ψ of the toroid solve in the same run), tuned to f₀ = 1 MHz with Q = 1 × 10⁶ at 30 mK (illustrative values) and read by the C1+low+RT dc SQUID chain of Ankel et al. (arXiv:2504.20398) at its scan-optimal coupling; the chain's noise parameter, its minimum noise temperature in units of ħω/2k_B, is η = 9.71. Each noise is referred to an EMF in the pickup and divided by the thermal noise of the pickup loss. SQUID backaction adds 0.83 of it; the SQUID imprecision stays below it over 182 Hz, about 182 linewidths. The correlation between imprecision and backaction moves the minimum of the total 52 Hz off resonance. The source gives the size of that correlation but not its sign s, so the side is a convention: the card shows s = +1 (minimum at +52 Hz); s = −1 puts it at −52 Hz.
<!-- --8<-- [end:readout] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:mech] -->
Mechanics: an illustrative solenoid winding (inner radius 0.30 m, 12 cm thick, 0.48 m tall, 3.2 × 10⁶ A turns, peak field 5.88 T) loaded by its own Lorentz force. Colour: von Mises stress from the axisymmetric elasticity solve, drawn by axionFEM's renderer on the cut planes of a 3D cutaway; lines: static field lines. The stress peaks at the inner midplane, 59.7 MPa (hoop stress 47.4 MPa); third- and second-order elements agree to 2 × 10⁻⁵. The same structural model takes cooldown contraction of bonded parts, and a steady thermal model with k(T) gives heat loads.
<!-- --8<-- [end:mech] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:reach] -->
**Beta.** Reach across mass: exclusion limits of 9 published cavity-haloscope runs (ADMX, CAPP, HAYSTAC, TASEH, ORGAN, QUAX), recomputed by axionfem.haloscope (filled) from each run's published cavity, magnet, receiver and scan parameters, with a few values inferred or assumed where a paper does not state them (listed in axionfem.haloscope_presets), next to the published limits (open). The recomputed limits lie between 0.75 and 1.15 times the published ones. Band: QCD axion models between the DFSZ and KSVZ couplings.
<!-- --8<-- [end:reach] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:fluids] -->
**Beta.** Fluids: natural convection in a differentially heated square cavity, Ra = 1 × 10⁵, Pr = 0.71 (steady Boussinesq, Taylor–Hood elements, Newton with Rayleigh-number continuation, one MPI rank). Colour: temperature; lines: streamlines (contours of the stream function). Average Nusselt number on the hot wall Nu = 4.522; two meshes agree to 2 × 10⁻⁵.
<!-- --8<-- [end:fluids] -->

<!-- --8<-- [start:chem] -->
**Beta.** Chemistry: primary current distribution on a disk electrode in an insulating plane (axisymmetric electrolyte potential with a half-space exterior). Colour: electrolyte potential φ_l/V; white: current lines, equal current between neighbours, crowding at the edge of the disk where the current density is singular. The total current matches Newman's closed form 4κr₀V to 1.4 × 10⁻⁴.
<!-- --8<-- [end:chem] -->
